learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how families act as our very first school and how neighbors and helpers join hands to build a happy, safe community!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Long before you ever step into a classroom, you learn how to walk, talk, share, and love from your family! A family is the basic and most important building block of society.
When many families live close together and share parks, roads, and markets, they form a community. Communities celebrate festivals together and help each other during tough times.
No one can do everything alone! We need farmers for food, doctors for medicine, and teachers for learning. Relying on each other for different needs is called interdependence.

fun_activity.title: 💌 The Helping Hands Thank You
fun_activity.instructions: Think of someone in your community who helps you every day, like a bus driver, a sweeper, or a shopkeeper. Make a colorful 'Thank You' card and give it to them to make their day!

quick_recap: ⭐ The family is our first school where we learn our basic values and habits.
⭐ A community is formed by groups of families living together and sharing resources.
⭐ Interdependence means we all need each other's skills and help to live a good life.
